events.factual_description: Brandon Seabrook's official schedule lists the Utility Modern Album Release Show at Public Records in Brooklyn on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 from 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM and names Seabrook on guitar, Bill Frisell on guitar, Rashaan Carter on bass and Marcus Gilmore on drums. Public Records lists the same night in the Sound Room at 7:00 PM and separately bills Zeena Parkins. The event record uses Seabrook's 7:30 PM performance time while preserving the venue's 7:00 PM event-calendar listing in the source record rather than guessing that it represents doors. Seabrook's artist-controlled Bandcamp page verifies Utility Modern as an October 2, 2026 release by the same quartet, with Seabrook on electric and acoustic guitars and banjo, Frisell on electric and acoustic guitars, Carter on bass and Gilmore on drums. Apple Music independently lists Utility Modern as an October 2 pre-release with eight tracks.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is not simply Bill Frisell appearing on somebody else's bill. Seabrook is putting the exact Utility Modern recording quartet onstage for the album-release show: two radically different guitar imaginations facing each other, with Rashaan Carter and Marcus Gilmore underneath, before the record itself arrives. It turns Seabrook's hyper-physical, genre-collision approach to guitar into a live conversation with one of the instrument's great living voices.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already within reach today, build the evening around Public Records. From the DMV, make room for the Brooklyn run only if the same-day logistics are sane; the exact release-lineup is a real draw, but the current evidence does not make this a one-night emergency worth contorting the whole day around.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho no es simplemente que Bill Frisell aparezca en el cartel de alguien más. Seabrook sube al escenario al cuarteto exacto que grabó Utility Modern para la noche de lanzamiento: dos imaginaciones de guitarra radicalmente distintas frente a frente, con Rashaan Carter y Marcus Gilmore sosteniendo la arquitectura, antes de que salga el disco. Es la manera hiperbólica, física y sin fronteras de Seabrook de tocar la guitarra puesta en conversación con una de las grandes voces vivas del instrumento.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está al alcance hoy, armaría la noche alrededor de Public Records. Desde el DMV, haría espacio para la corrida a Brooklyn sólo si la logística del mismo día es sensata; el lineup exacto del disco sí jala, pero la evidencia actual no convierte esta fecha en una emergencia de una sola noche que obligue a torcer todo el día.
